snippet.title: Gido Gido: Kaiju Battle Party Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gido Gido is a chaotic 4v4 online co-op party brawler developed by Myth & Mortar studio. In the game, your adorable kaiju squad can fuse into one massive monster as you clash for territory by toppling enemy bases while leveling a bustling, fully destructible cozy city. 

Each Gido has unique abilities, with the game’s signature twist being that players can fuse together to form larger, more powerful Gido with combined abilities. Combine and conquer!

Join our Discord for the latest news and to request closed beta access. Also, please be sure to wishlist on Steam!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4234210/Gido_Gido_Kaiju_Battle_Party/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=Wishlist
Discord: https://discord.gg/gidogido
Twitter: https://x.com/GidoGidoGame
